This Pull Request updates dependency eslint from version `3.19.0` to `4.0.0`

### Changelog

#### 4.0.0 / 2017-06-12

  * 4.0.0
  * Build: changelog update for 4.0.0
  * Chore: avoid using deprecated rules on ESLint codebase ([#8708](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/8708))
    This updates eslint-config-eslint to remove deprecated rules in favor of their newer alternatives.
  * Chore: upgrade deps. ([#8684](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/8684))
  * Fix: Semi-Style only check for comments when tokens exist (fixes [#8696](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/8696)) ([#8697](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/8697))
  * Fix: Add space between async and param on fix (fixes [#8682](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/8682)) ([#8693](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/8693))
  * Chore: enable no-multiple-empty-lines on ESLint codebase ([#8694](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/8694))
    (refs https://github.com/eslint/eslint/pull/8679#discussion_r120498302)
  * Update: Add support for parens on left side for-loops (fixes: [#8393](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/8393)) ([#8679](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/8679))
  * Docs: Correct the comment in an example for `no-mixed-requires` ([#8686](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/8686))
  * Chore: remove dead code from prefer-const ([#8683](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/8683))
    This code was added to work around a bug in acorn (https://github.com/ternjs/acorn/issues/487), which has since been fixed.
